title: From Playing Cards to 1.59 Billion Games
description:
Nintendo started in 1889, making playing cards.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: History of Nintendo: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Nintendo
- Nintendo IR: Dedicated Video Game Sales Units (as of September 30, 2026): https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/hard_soft/index.html
- Wikipedia: List of best-selling game consoles: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_best-selling_game_consoles

From Wikipedia (History of Nintendo): Fusajiro Yamauchi founded Nintendo on September 23, 1889 in Kyoto to make hanafuda playing cards; in the 1960s it ran a taxi company in Kyoto and tried a food company with instant rice and a vacuum cleaner; in 1964 the playing card business reached saturation and the stock fell from 900 yen to 60 yen (a drop of about 93%, our math); the Game & Watch handheld line ran from 1980 to 1991. From Nintendo IR (as of September 30, 2026): Nintendo Switch 157.20 million units and 1,593.87 million software units; Nintendo Switch 2 26.35 million units. From Wikipedia (List of best-selling game consoles): the Switch is the second best-selling console of all time. Photos: Wikimedia Commons (credits below). Not financial advice.

cta: Switch or Game Boy? Comment your favorite.

scenes.narration: Nintendo started in 1889, making playing cards.
Today, people have bought 1.59 billion of its Switch games.
But in between? A taxi company. Instant rice. Even a vacuum.
Then card sales crashed. Its stock lost over 90 percent.
So it bet on games instead. Pocket games, then home consoles.
Now the Switch is the second best-selling console ever.
